summary.text: Paul Corderman is a Republican member of the Maryland State Senate from District 2 who has served since September 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Hagerstown city council member and auto body shop manager, he served in the House of Delegates from 2017 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Corderman was born in Hagerstown, Maryland, on September 1, 1977, attended North Hagerstown High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2000.
He worked as a repair coordinator at Progressive Insurance from 2003 to 2013 and as shop manager at Mace Auto Body in Smithsburg from 2013 to 2019.
He served on the Hagerstown City Council in 2016 and 2017.
Corderman served in the House of Delegates from December 20, 2017, to August 31, 2020, and has been a member of the Senate since September 1, 2020.
He was first elected to the Senate in November 2022.

He serves on the Budget and Taxation Committee and its Capital Budget, Education, Business, and Administration, and Procurement subcommittees, as well as the Spending Affordability Committee and the Joint Audit and Evaluation Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.
